steps.title: Структура эссе
steps.html:
Абзац 1 формулирует вопрос и говорит, что будет в эссе. Мнение здесь ещё не высказывается.

Средние абзацы — по одному аргументу, каждый с причиной и доказательством. Один абзац — одна мысль.

On the other hand отмечает поворот. До него — одна сторона, после — другая.

Вывод должен вытекать из сказанного. Если его можно было написать без средних абзацев, эссе не сработало.

steps.title: Should advertising to children be banned?
steps.html:
Читайте как автор: один абзац — один аргумент, а вывод вытекает из них.

Образец

Several countries have banned or restricted advertising aimed at children, and others are considering it. This essay looks at the main arguments on each side and reaches a conclusion.

One major advantage of a ban is that young children cannot recognize what an advert is doing. Research reported last year found that under-eights do not reliably understand that an advert is trying to sell them something; they take it as information. If a viewer cannot see the purpose of the message, the usual defence — that people are free to ignore advertising — does not apply to them.

A second argument is about what is advertised. The products aimed at children are not evenly spread across the market: they are heavily weighted towards food and toys, and the food is rarely the food anyone would recommend. A government that spends money on children's health and then allows it to be advertised against is arguing with itself.

On the other hand, a significant drawback is the cost. Children's television is expensive to make and is funded almost entirely by advertising; where bans have been introduced, the amount of home-produced children's programming has fallen. The children still watch television. They simply watch programmes made somewhere else, for someone else.

There is also the question of where a ban would stop. Advertising reaches children through sport, through social media and through their parents, and a rule that covers television and nothing else moves the money rather than removing it.

All things considered, I would support a ban on advertising aimed at the under-twelves, but only if it were funded properly. A ban on its own removes the income and leaves the problem; a ban with public funding for children's programming removes both. In conclusion, the argument is not really about advertising at all — it is about who is willing to pay for what children watch.

  5. 5 · Второй аргумент с той стороны.
  6. 6 · All things considered: вывод, который следует из написанного выше.
On the one hand…One major advantage is…A significant drawback is…On the other hand…However…All things considered…In conclusion…

steps.title: Урок 36 пройден — уровень завершён
steps.sub: Юнит 12 · Урок 3 из 3 — дальше последний тест
items: Я соглашаюсь и возражаю с той силой, которую имею в виду.
Я могу написать эссе, которое взвешивает обе стороны и приходит к выводу.
Я точно передаю и утверждения, и вопросы.
